content.short: LandRocker Miner is a Telegram-friendly mining game connected to the LandRocker sci-fi gaming universe.
content.description: LandRocker Miner is tied to LandRocker, a sci-fi Web3 game universe built around exploration, resource collection, crafting, and progression. The project uses the Telegram-friendly miner format as an accessible entry point into that broader game loop. It is listed as a game because the core experience is mining, upgrading, and progressing through gameplay rather than financial trading. Now, systems deeper than any of us imagined are stirring powered by technologies backed by science and forged in collaboration with giants.
